settings.label: Code
settings.info: Create the code under Discounts first. The block only shows or applies it; Shopify decides whether it is valid. Nothing shows while this is empty.

settings.label: Text
settings.info: Describe what the code really gives, for example "10% off your first order".

settings.label: When tapped
settings.info: Apply adds the code to the cart and shows Shopify's answer; an invalid code is reported as not valid.
